name: uip-sdk
summary: UIP - Universal Inference Platform Python SDK (two-tier multi-tenant unit+user isolation). 0.26.0 aligns error semantics with the high-concurrency layer: header-first discrimination (X-UIP-Admission / X-UIP-Circuit) raises CapacityExceededError / UpstreamCircuitOpenError instead of UIGOfflineError; adds TenantQuotaExceededError, StreamInterruptedError, opt-in Retry-After backoff (RetryPolicy) and X-Request-Id correlation.
